messages.text:
"3D post nuclear apocalyptic looter shooter and extraction shooter combo. Two separate game locations, the bunker city underground and the upper world above ground. The player can chose to shop for weapons and gear or furniture for the apartment that they can get to from the bunker city and customize. The player can also earn money, gear, weapons and decarations by looting the above groud world infested with irradiated monsters as well as volatile and violent weather like radiation storms.
"
